name: Teddy
description: Classify the selected tab(s) into tab groups using an OpenAI-compatible LLM, and save tab groups as bookmark folders.

classify-selected-tabs.description: Classify the selected tab(s) into groups

move-tabs-to-start.description: Move the selected tab(s) to the start of the tab strip

move-tabs-to-end.description: Move the selected tab(s) to the end of the tab strip

save-tab-group.description: Save the current tab's group to bookmarks

save-tab-groups-in-window.description: Save all tab groups in the window to bookmarks
